metadata.title: Pricing | Slashie
metadata.description: Customers use Slashie for free. Workers get free quotes every month, or unlimited quotes with Slashie Unlimited. Job payments stay between customer and worker.

header.heading: Simple plans. Clear quotes.
header.body: Customers post tasks for free. Workers start free and upgrade when they want unlimited quotes.

free.title: Free
free.subtitle: For getting started
features: Quote on up to {count} new tasks a month

plans.purchasesNote: Purchases are processed securely. On iOS and Android, subscription management may open your platform billing settings when available.

unavailable.heading: Pricing isn't loading
unavailable.body: We couldn't load plan details just now. Customers always post tasks for free, and workers can start free.

customers.question: Do customers pay anything?
customers.answer: No. Posting a task, comparing quotes and choosing a worker are free.

freeQuotes.question: How do free quotes work?
freeQuotes.answer: On the free plan you can quote on up to {count} new tasks a month. The count resets on the 1st of each month.

unlimited.question: What does Slashie Unlimited include?
unlimited.answer: Unlimited quotes. It's a subscription for sending quotes, not a fee on the jobs you win.

payments.question: How do workers get paid?
payments.answer: Customers pay workers directly, outside Slashie. Slashie never holds or handles job money, and takes no cut.

trial.question: What happens after the free trial?
trial.answer: Slashie Unlimited continues at {priceLine} unless you cancel before the trial ends.

cancel.question: Can I cancel?
cancel.answer: Yes, anytime from Billing. You keep unlimited quotes until the end of your trial or billing period, then move to the free plan.

metadata.title: 收費方案 | Slashie
metadata.description: 客戶免費使用 Slashie。工作者每月有免費報價，或訂閱 Slashie Unlimited 無限報價。任務付款由客戶和工作者直接安排。

header.heading: 簡單方案，清楚報價。
header.body: 客戶免費發布任務。工作者先免費開始，需要無限報價時再升級。

free.title: 免費方案
free.subtitle: 適合剛開始
features: 每月可為最多 {count} 個新任務報價
就任務與客戶傳送訊息

unlimited.subtitle: 適合活躍工作者
features: 包含免費方案的所有功能

plans.purchasesNote: 購買會安全處理。在 iOS 和 Android 上，訂閱管理可能會開啟平台帳單設定（如適用）。

unavailable.heading: 暫時無法載入收費
unavailable.body: 目前未能載入方案詳情。客戶發布任務一律免費，工作者亦可免費開始。

customers.question: 客戶需要付費嗎？
customers.answer: 不需要。發布任務、比較報價和選擇工作者都是免費的。

freeQuotes.question: 免費報價如何計算？
freeQuotes.answer: 使用免費方案時，你每月可為最多 {count} 個新任務報價，額度於每月 1 日重設。

unlimited.question: Slashie Unlimited 包括甚麼？
unlimited.answer: 無限報價。這是發送報價的訂閱，並非從你接到的工作中收取的費用。

payments.question: 工作者如何收款？
payments.answer: 客戶在 Slashie 以外直接付款給工作者。Slashie 不會持有或經手任何工作款項，亦不抽佣金。

trial.question: 免費試用結束後會怎樣？
trial.answer: 除非你在試用期結束前取消，Slashie Unlimited 會以 {priceLine} 繼續。

cancel.question: 可以取消嗎？
cancel.answer: 可以，隨時在帳單頁取消。你可繼續無限報價至試用期或計費期結束，之後轉回免費方案。
